column2: Always 'Alta' + name + 'Residences' (larger buildings) or 'House' / 'Residence' (smaller). Use on site, listings, signage, pitches.
Short name + unit number, e.g. Meridian 204, Cedar 1, Harbour 2.
Don't use names that promise a view or feature we don't have. Don't drop 'Alta' on public-facing pages.
SR Residency, SR Homes, Chaitanya stay as street-address names only — not shown as brand.
